overview: Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword made out of emerald blocks: diamond's mining and damage, netherite's durability, and twice diamond's enchantability.

2.2.1: Mod Menu's Donate button leads to sponsoring the author on GitHub. Nothing in play changes.
2.2.0: Emerald tools mine and hit exactly like diamond (speed 8, +3 damage), and last as long as netherite, the same deal as Emerald Armor.
The emerald hoe swings like a hoe again; it had been hitting for 4.5 at axe speed.
Tools already in a world take the new numbers.
2.1.0: With Smithing Templates installed, emerald tools take trims at the smithing table, and the trim shows on the tool.
2.0.2: A mod menu icon of the tools, framed the way Emerald Armor's is.
2.0.1: The readme owns up to what the hoe costs in emeralds.
2.0.0: The full set of tools, with the advancement that unlocks each recipe.
The emerald hoe turns up the odd emerald while tilling.
A tool tells the client what it is, so it looks right in every hand.
